title: Steak and Atakilt Stir Fry
description: A Chinese-inspired stir fry combining the bold flavors of Ethiopia with tender steak and crunchy atakilt.
instructions: Preheat the wok or large skillet to 400°F (200°C).
Season the steak with salt and pepper.
In a small bowl, mix together the berbere, niter kibbeh, and soy sauce.
Add 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the preheated wok and add the steak.
Sear the steak for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches your desired level of doneness.
Remove the steak from the wok and set it aside to rest.
In the same wok, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil.
Add the atakilt and zesty red bell pepper to the wok.
Stir-fry the atakilt and bell pepper for 4-5 minutes, or until they are tender.
Return the steak to the wok and stir-fry everything together for 1-2 minutes.
Serve the steak and atakilt stir-fry hot, garnished with additional berbere if desired.
